# TokenIssueScope

`schemas/api/scope/token-issue.json`

The scope of token.issue (docs/design/m0/04 "Token administration", 14 M4): the live operator or supervisor that receives another token. The token is minted by the request layer, never named here; its secret reaches only the live response of the call that applied the issue (14 N3), and a retry under the same idempotency key replays without it. Only an operator issues in this build.
